md-county-officials.area: Maryland — all 23 counties and Baltimore City
md-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county or Baltimore City, and not its council, executive, commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
md-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Maryland's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
md-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

md-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City, Town or Village card names the city, town or village you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
md-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Maryland's cities, towns and villages has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
md-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's, town's or village's mayor or council members, or a city's, town's or village's own published list of them.

md-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
md-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Maryland's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
md-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
